title: Palestine And The Man Of Sin

sense.text:
“Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.” It’s telling you that continent was called the land of Ham. That’s where those dark Hamites, the dark races, were.

The Bible dictionary says Ham was the progenitor of the dark races, but not the Negro: the Egyptians, Ethiopians, Libyans and Canaanites. The same dictionary says ruddy is used for a fair complexion ‘in contrast to the dark skin of the Hebrews.’ Was King David a Hebrew? Was Jesus Christ a Hebrew? It’s telling you they’re all black people, and they know the Negroes come from the Hebrews. Ruddy just means clear brown skin, no blemishes, no freckles, no spots; the white man plays with words. So the question is: who renamed the continent of Ham?

precepts.why: “And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham”. See that: the tabernacles of Ham. Egypt sat in the land of Ham.

We often read this, because the continent is no longer called Ham; it is called Africa. “Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever”: that there is the so-called white man. Their inward thought is that their houses will continue forever, “and their dwelling places to all generations”. Here it comes: “they call their lands after their own names.” They call the lands that they take over, that they conquer, after their own names.

The history books bear it out. The Greeks made the name Carthage; the Latins, and the Latins is the white man, that’s Esau, gave the name Africa to the region around Carthage, and started calling us Phoenicians. From the Greeks to the Latins, it’s the same race of people. Josephus says that after the nations were dispersed, some kept the names God first gave them and some lost them, and ‘they were the Greeks who became the authors of such mutations’: when they grew potent they claimed to themselves the glory of antiquity, giving names to the nations that sounded well in Greek. Any Babylon, any Egyptians, that was the Greeks; the white man took all authority and antiquity. They’re the ones that put the name Africa on there.

sense.text: Who were the Greeks? From the time of Philip and Alexander. “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian”, who “had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes”, “reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”: Alexander the Greek became the first.

He “took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him; whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.” This is when they changed the names of all the people they started to conquer. Egypt is Greek; that’s not the original name of it, it was Mizraim. They changed all the names.

“So Alexander reigned twelves years, and then died. And his servants bare rule every one in his place. And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

And who were they? The old books say King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac, and that Alexander, reputed son of Philip, slew Darius the younger; the genealogy of Philip runs back through Rome and Eliphaz to Esau, son of Isaac. So it shouldn’t be no question what Alexander the Greek and his father Philip were. You got a dude on YouTube asking what happened to them; they still around. Edom is here. And the Muhammadans called the Europeans, the Byzantine Greeks, the Romans, by one name, Roum: in the land of Roum and of the Maghreb was a great empire of the Greeks, and Philip was its king, a descendant of Esau.

All Arabs, following Muhammad’s example, claim descent from Ishmael; the scholars know the Arabs descend from Ishmael. In the news today they’re trying to say the modern-day Arabs are the ancient Philistines. That’s not true, hell no. The Bible clears up all the nonsense, all the news garbage that’s out there; we just got to read. “And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal, and the Mehunims.” It’s telling you the Arabians and the Philistines are two different people, not the same race. The Philistines were Hamites.

The word Palestine comes from Philistia, the name given by Greek writers; remember Josephus said the Greeks became the authors of such mutations. With the British conquest in 1917 to 1918, Palestine became the official name of a territory: Britain put that name on it. They called them Palestinian Arabs, and only since 1964 have they been called Palestinians. Under the British mandate, the Jewish community living there was also called Palestinian. All this stuff we seeing out on the news is new. That lays the foundation for today.

“Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed”. Initially the thought is that’s Assyria, which is correct, but it wasn’t just Assyria that did this. Many nations have done this, and in this context we talking about white folks.

Here is an unrighteous decree: the anti-literacy laws in the United States from 1740 to 1867 prohibited black people from learning to read or write. White elites feared black literacy would threaten slavery, enabling enslaved people to escape, share ideas and revolt; those caught learning to read or write faced violent punishment, being sold, or even death. You had the slave trade, Black Codes, Jim Crow, segregation: Jim Crow laws banned blacks from restaurants, hospitals, parks, schools and barber shops; it was unlawful for a negro and a white person to play pool together; colored persons could not be buried on ground set apart for whites; books could not be interchanged between white and colored schools. That’s the Southern Kingdom.

And we rarely discuss the American Indians, the tribe of Gad, Reuben and so forth: that’s what they did to the Northern Kingdom. From 1819 to 1969 the US government took the children from their families to eradicate their cultures and seize tribal land. They forced them onto reservations, and what are they reserving them for? Day schools weren’t aggressive enough; their ultimate plan was to totally wipe them out. ‘Kill the Indian in him and save the man.’ At least 523 boarding schools, a third of them run by religious groups; physical abuse, disease and malnutrition, many children sexually abused by the priests and the nuns, and now they’re finding thousands of dead bones of children, buried in unmarked graves, because they murdered them. And they have not changed to this day. Now they want an apology from the president and the pope. An apology is nothing, an empty word. It ain’t giving you back your ancestors, your land, your dignity. That’s why the Lord said he’s got to raise Judah first.

“To turn aside the needy from judgment”: we’re the needy, turned aside from God’s judgment. “That widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless”. Remember when Malcolm X’s daddy got murdered and his mama went to get the insurance money: Esau kept the money and said he killed himself, that he tied himself up and laid himself down on the train tracks. And after the father was murdered they took all the kids and put them in the foster care system. That’s what they did.

“Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners”: without God we going to bow down under the prisoners, “and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.” The Lord has been very angry, but his hand is stretched out to us.
“O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.” The Lord used Assyria to whip the hell out of us. That’s what he did.

precepts.why: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword”. The wicked is God’s sword. So when we go back to Isaiah 10:5, the Assyrian is the rod of God’s anger: God uses the wicked as his sword to punish his people.

Look at that: the pope bending down. “Never trust thine enemy”: God says never trust your enemies, “for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” A piece of iron will surely rust in time, and their wickedness is just like that.

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching”: see him humbling himself, the pope bends down and kisses the hand, going crouching just like you see there. “Yet take good heed and beware of him”: take good heed means beware. “And thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass”, like you wiped a foggy mirror, “and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.”

You going to realize the Catholic Church and these white folks have not changed at all; they’re the same yesterday and today. Y’all keep thinking these people change. If the pope changed, why didn’t he give you your lands back, all the gold and the diamonds and the jewels that they stole? Ever since the ’60s and ’70s they say we ain’t getting lynched no more, so the white man changed. No. Trust me, you’re all going to see this man ain’t changed; he’s the same.

sense.text:
Now let’s talk about these other people, and what God calls the white man; don’t get mad, but God calls the white man a few things in the Bible. “And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod”. Put Ashdod on the screen: it’s right there, above Jerusalem, and that’s all white folks. Secular and religious politicians in Ashdod, ultra Orthodox Jews gathered for a rabbi’s funeral in Ashdod, Ashdod students, ultra Orthodox families casting away sins before Yom Kippur and inspecting citrus for Sukkot in Ashdod, Israel. These are the people. God called them bastards.

“And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.” God said I’mma cut off the pride of the Palestinians. Write that down: the Philistines there is the Palestinians; Ashdod there is the white man that calls himself Jewish.

How come preachers don’t read that, when it says a bastard? They’ll be at home right now saying we using cuss words. It’s in the Bible, sister. God calls them bastards. Well, you ain’t supposed to say it. Shut up, you damn lying Christians.

“Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.” Once the Lord allows Assyria to do what they were going to do to us, the Northern Kingdom in particular, he said I’m going to punish Assyria. The punishment of Assyria goes twofold: it happened back then, and it’s going to happen again today.

The ancient artifacts show who the Israelites were: Assyrians leading away the ten tribes as slaves in 722 and 721 BCE. Look at the hair, look at the nose: those are not Caucasians, not Edom, not Israelis; these are Negroes, black people. They carved peppercorn hair in stone to make it look like afro hair. Assyria tied us up, stabbed us in the neck, and put hooks in our noses and lips to control us, pulling us this way and that. Women and children taken away to captivity, brown faces. On TV they push the lying narrative.

So Assyria does refer to ancient Assyria, but many times in the scriptures, prophetically, it’s referring to the modern state of Israel. When Assyria took over the Northern Kingdom it put transplants in the land; that’s why it’s a metaphor.

precepts.why: Regarding Assyria, this is what we all need to understand in this world of men: “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” That proves it don’t matter who the president is. God turns the heart of the king and makes them do what he wants them to do. We got to vote for this one and that one? No, it don’t matter who’s in the seat. God is in control: he used the king of Assyria against us, and he will punish him.

sense.text: We start with Babylon, and from Babylon it goes to Assyria: Babylon here is America, and Assyria is the modern state of Israel. “Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”. Scholars will say this is talking about ancient Nebuchadnezzar. No, it’s talking about the United States of America, and as we read down it bears itself witness. “How hath the oppressor ceased!”: Babylon is an oppressing kingdom, and America is an oppressive system. “The golden city ceased!”: America is the golden city, the best country on earth.
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked”: the staff meaning rulership, “and the sceptre of the rulers.”

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: in anger, with a continual stroke, meaning it don’t stop. The most bomb-dropping country: a nation-state version of a psychopath, an article says, with an addiction to bombing innocent people. Women, kids, boys, girls, civilians. The Christian church don’t talk about this. When you see what Israel is doing to the Palestinians, guess who’s dropping them: America is behind it. America says ceasefire, but behind closed doors keeps giving them money and weapons to kill more.

“He that ruled the nations in anger”: he does not rule nations in happiness. “Is persecuted, and none hindereth”: America will be persecuted, it’s sure to come, and once that persecution starts nobody’s going to be able to stop it.
“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When Babylon is persecuted, everybody is going to break forth into singing and rejoicing.

“Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee”: the fir trees are the people that live there, “and the cedars of Lebanon”, the people of Lebanon, “saying, Since thou art laid down”, since America was taken down, laid down meaning fallen, “no feller is come up against us”: nobody’s killing us no more. Like Deacon Malachi said, all the weapons Israel is using in Lebanon are from the United States of America; they are complicit.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”: as America is persecuted and coming down. The hell is referring to the nations, and it explains itself as we read on. “It stirreth up the dead for thee”: the hell is the dead. “Even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” That’s the proof: the kings of the nations are the chief ones, are the dead, are in hell, living underneath the United States of America economically. America subdues all nations, and the nations are pissed off. The G20 summit is an example: all the kings of the earth.

“All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” Because America is persecuted and none hindereth (verse 6), all the nations are going to look at America and say, you have an Achilles heel, a weak spot; now we know how to hit you.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”: their pride. Look at his face: America First. The Most High said your pomp is going to be brought down to the grave. “And the noise of thy viols”: we usually refer to viols as music, but the noise of their viols is their media, their rhetoric, their policies that go out through their media. Their media is worldwide, and everyone is hypnotized by the media of the United States of America. “The worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee”: corruption.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” Notice what he’s calling Babylon. Verse 4 says this proverb is against the king of Babylon, the oppressor, the golden city; verse 8 speaks of it laid down, fallen; now verse 12 calls Babylon Lucifer. The word Lucifer means lightbearer. This is Lucifer the lightbearer: America raises the torch in her right hand to bear light to the nations, that she is supreme, and all nations are to follow her policies, her concepts, her ideas.

“How art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” How did they weaken the nations? Interventions, another word for coups: 469 US military interventions since 1798, 251 since 1991, by the Congressional Research Service. They send operatives in to destabilize countries; right now, while Israel drops bombs on Lebanon, America is trying to put its own people in the government there. And economic sanctions: the economic hitman destabilizing and corrupting whole governments, and a map where everything in red is sanctioned by the United States. America is the Beast, the one that controls the world’s economy. If you don’t like what America said, they will shut you down financially, even your food. He basically sanctioned the whole planet except America, the damn bastard. If he ain’t the devil, where is he?

“I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: this began in 1969, and from there space shuttles, moon landings, now satellites to Mars and Venus. This ain’t talking about a spirit guy; it’s an oppressive kingdom on earth that weakens nations, bombs nations, and goes to the moon and beyond.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: the congregation is the Israelites, and the sides of the north means North America. This is how they sit on us: it’s called slavery. A documentary history of slavery in North America; 1619, the origins of slavery in North America. In the sides of the north.

“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: their planes. “I will be like the most High”: he painted himself worldwide as God. You think about God in the earth, you think of a white man, not Chinese, Japanese, African or Arab. The religion of whiteness: they paint themselves as God, as Christ, as the angels. They became the people of antiquity, they are Sumer, they are Nimrod, they are everybody; the last samurai, the last of the Mohicans, Django. They are everybody on the planet earth.
“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.” You shall be destroyed.

You got to take this verse slow. “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”. It’s telling you Lucifer is man on earth; Babylon, the oppressive kingdom, is man on earth, and it’s the white man. No ifs, ands or buts about it, this so-called white man. It goes right back to verse 6, he that ruled the nations in anger: they’re the ones that shake kingdoms by dropping bombs. Nobody else is doing this kind of destruction but this red dragon beast; that’s why the Most High put that color on him, so you can’t make a mistake.

When y’all read this on the street, stress the man. Don’t just run by it, because Negroes are simple, we are slow minded people. Repeat it and ask the listener: did it say a spirit, or did it say the man? The man. And when you ask him on the street he got to look back to see if the man is looking at him.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”: you’re looking at the devastation in real time, and you sit in church confused about who this is talking about; you’re purposely stupid. “That opened not the house of his prisoners?” Where are the prisoners? Remember, he’s sitting on us in the sides of the north. He didn’t open his kingdom to us.

“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.” All the kings of the earth wait for their moment to rule. Once America goes down, it’s game on, every nation for himself; that’s why it’s called a race. Every race wants to rule and dominate, but for some reason Negroes don’t want to rule nothing; we don’t even want to rule our damn house.

“But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch”: this white man is going to be cast out of his grave like an abominable branch, “as a carcase trodden under feet.” This white man that did so much devastation and destruction will not have an honorable end. That’s what the Bible prophesies.

“Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial”: they’re not going to have an honorable burial, “because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people”. Put Fauci back up: they orchestrated that, it’s all coming out now, these demons orchestrated it to lower the population. They don’t care if they got to kill a couple of million white folks to get what they want.

“The seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” The white man, Esau, Edom, is the seed of evildoers; they are the children of the devil. Put up Congress: that’s the seed of evildoers, at least a portion of them. Take your emotions out of it; this ain’t personal, most of y’all the white man sure been good to you, nice house and home. We just telling you what the Bible says: Babylon would destroy nations and kingdoms, that’s America; it calls them Lucifer; it calls them the seed of evildoers.

“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”. Nobody wants to talk about this; the Christian church won’t. For the sins of their fathers. They’re quick to say, I never did that, that was my fathers. God said you going to pay for the sins of your fathers, because you are your fathers. “That they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.” God said they will never rise again: once America goes down, they’re never going to rise back up. This is war. And they will not possess the land again, the land of Israel included.

precepts.why: Who is the congregation that Babylon, Lucifer, would sit on? “All the congregation of Israel”. The congregation is the Israelites. So the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north is the king of Babylon sitting on Israel in North America: slavery.

That goes with the seed of evildoers; put them things together. “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”. You want to know who the devil is? The Bible tells you who the children of the devil are: the devil got children on earth. The seed of evildoers in Isaiah 14:20 is the white man, Esau, Edom; they are the children of the devil.

sense.text:
The argument always comes up: why no two-state solution? The land is God’s, and God gave it to us, the twelve tribes of Israel. Even the white man is saying America is the problem with all nations on the planet: a reporter asking an official what gives him the right to lecture other countries while this administration has financed a genocide in Gaza, and a man saying one country alone stands in the way of a state of Palestine, the United States of America and the Israel lobby. You’re witnessing the revealing of who this man really is, and they can never come back from it. Even when they try to initiate peace, sudden destruction will follow: you killed generations of a civilization, and the Arabs will not let that slide.

“For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”. The Lord’s going to cut off all the men, because the men are the ones that produce the children. He said I’m going to get rid of everybody.
“I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.” God’s going to destroy America.
“The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand”. All God’s purpose shall stand.

“That I will break the Assyrian in my land”: God is talking about the state of Israel. He’s calling the modern state of Israel, since 1948, the Assyrian. “And upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them”: the yoke is the apartheid system they have established in the state of Israel, these settlers and their movements, an apartheid regime on the modern-day Palestinians, the Arabs. God said I’m going to destroy these Assyrians in my land and take that yoke off the people that’s in my land.

“This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth”: this is what everything’s about, “and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.” “For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it?” Who can change God’s purpose?
“In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.” That’s the year Isaiah saw this vision.

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina”: we read at the beginning of the class that Palestina is the name for the modern-day Arabs. His land is the land of Israel, and he’s calling the people occupying it the Assyrian and Palestina: two groups of people in God’s land.

“Because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: America is the one that funnels the weapons to put that yoke on them. God said I’m going to break America, and when I do, this place in Israel is going to go down too. The rod of this white man on the Arabs shall be broken, but God says don’t rejoice too quick. Once that goes down the Arabs are going to be rejoicing, screaming all through the streets. “For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice”: this is a missile, “and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.” God is telling you what’s going to happen in the last days in the land of Israel.

“And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”: that’s our people; we are the firstborn of the poor. “And the needy shall lie down in safety”: we are the needy, not those people over there that God names the Assyrians, not the Palestinians. “And I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.”

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved”: Palestine will be wiped off the earth. God’s going to take out this white man that’s over there, and he’s going to take out the Arabs too. “For there shall come from the north a smoke”: this is a missile, a bomb, “and none shall be alone in his appointed times”: total destruction. Arab going to get it, white man going to get it, everybody in the land going to get it.
“That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” We are the poor of Zion, the poor that the Lord is looking for.

precepts.why: How you know the firstborn? “And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn”. We’re the firstborn. So the firstborn of the poor that shall feed in Isaiah 14:30, and the needy that shall lie down in safety, are our people, the Israelites, not the Assyrian and not Palestina.

sense.text: “Under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire”: destruction.

“And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame”: the Holy One for a flame, that’s Christ. “And it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day”: it’s going to take the Lord one day.

“Both soul and body”: this destruction that’s coming is going to destroy both soul and body. “And they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth”: when your standard bearer drops, you have lost the war.
“And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.” It’s going to be so few people left over there that a child is going to be able to number them.

“The remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob”: that’s us, you and me that repent of our sins. If you don’t know who Israel truly is you’re going to be confused: you read Isaiah 14 and everybody over there gets wiped off the planet, and now this talks about escaping. This is the real Israelites escaping. “Shall no more again stay upon him that smote them”: we ain’t going to stay on the white man that smote us. Mr. white man, can you give me public assistance, a job, an education? No, we ain’t staying on him no more. “But shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth”: we going to totally depend on the Lord, in truth, not in lies.
“The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.” We’re going to return to the Mighty God.

“For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return”. Everybody ain’t going to return. Although we’re the largest nation on the planet, God says only a remnant shall return, so don’t get your feelings hurt when people say I don’t want to hear that; let them die, let them go. “The consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness”: this destruction that’s coming is all based upon righteousness. Everyone’s going to get paid back for the evil they have done on this earth, “in the midst of all the land.”

“O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian”: that’s us. It’s the Assyrian, the modern state of Israel, that’s here making laws and legislation of hate speech: you can’t say this, it’s anti-Semitism. And they’re going to make more laws soon to come. “He shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt”: God is prophesying these people are going to smite you with a rod just like ancient Egypt did. The Assyrian are these so-called people we call Jewish today.

“For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction. And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb”.

“His burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck”. The same way they have a yoke on the Palestinians over there, they have a yoke on our people over here. “And the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing”: the anointing is Christ, the Holy Spirit. Christ is going to break their yoke from us.

“At Michmash he hath laid up his carriages”: weapons of war, the vehicles of war. “Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled”: all nations are going to flee when war comes; these are nations at war. “He shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem”: that’s us.

“Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror”: God’s going to bring terror on the land of Israel; he’s going to destroy them. “And the high ones of stature shall be hewn down”, cut down, “and the haughty shall be humbled.”

“And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron”: an iron weapon of war, a missile. “And Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one”: the mighty one is the Lord. It goes back to verse 21, “The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.”

I’m dealing with prophecy today. “And in the latter time of their kingdom”: this is the fourth empire, the Roman Empire, which has gone up to America today. The white man’s empire. “When the transgressors are come to the full”: when the sins are come to the full.

“A king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” Don’t look for one particular guy. They move, they die and return. A president can only lead for two terms max, that’s eight years, so stop looking for that. Even a pope may die, and they got to have somebody take his seat. So if you hear me say the pope, I’m not meaning just a pope: Esau in general. That guy’s just one of the leaders, but you got archbishops and all these titles these dudes got. There’s a lot of them.

Commentators often say this is Antiochus Epiphanes. Epiphanes is an ancient Greek epithet that means manifest, God manifest on earth; it was used by several Hellenistic rulers, including Antiochus IV Epiphanes, king of the Seleucid Empire from 175 to 164 BC. Christians, Seventh-day Adventists, Jehovah’s Witnesses, will say it was only back then. But the title ‘Vicar of Christ on Earth’ is used in the Roman Catholic Church for the pope, because he is said to stand in place of Jesus Christ and possess his authority in the church. Aren’t those names similar? Epiphanes was God manifest on earth. Some commentators just say Antichrist, some just say Antiochus, but it’s both of them. It goes into both of them.

The scholars know who this is. In The Rise of Christendom by Edwin Johnson, published in 1890: the medieval chroniclers say expressly that Edom means the Roman Empire, or the European powers. So they read about the last, fourth empire and the churches say that’s Rome, but they don’t say that’s Edom. One of the earliest, Benjamin of Tudela, 1160, calls Rome the Edomite capital and the pope the head of the Edomite religion. So you mean some scholars don’t know what’s going on? Oh, they know. It’s only black and Latino people that don’t know what’s going on. That same book goes into how the pope’s Jesuits find records and make slight alterations in the books: forgeries ‘executed with sufficient cleverness by the mercenary servants of the Pope to deceive generations of scholars’.

sense.text:
Daniel 8:24 said his power shall be mighty but not by his own power. That’s where this comes in. “And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this is the United States of America, the beast coming up out of the earth.

“And he had two horns like a lamb”: democracy and republicanism, a two-party political system. These are the two horns, Republican and Democrat. Then people say, I think we should vote Democrat. What part of the demon, what part of the beast are you going to vote for? I’m thinking Republican. You simple as hell.

“And he spake as a dragon”: why does he speak like a dragon? Because their policies are against God’s laws.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: he exercises all the power of Rome. When you read the history, Rome was a power on earth; now Rome is religious, but America has come up in power. That is why the power of that king in Daniel 8 is not his own: America is his muscle.

“And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast”: to worship Rome. “Whose deadly wound was healed”: the healing is called the Renaissance. Everything we have, from the dollar bill written in Roman numerals, to the days and the months, to many of the holidays, is all from Rome.

“And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, August 6, 1945. That’s how he made fire come down from heaven. They called that bomb Little Boy, and the next one Fat Man; they dropped those two bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945. Fire had never been seen on the planet earth like that before. Hundreds of thousands of people, charcoal, destroyed. When Esau watches what his weapons do, that’s his aphrodisiac. He gets turned on seeing people die at the work of his hands; he gets excited dropping bombs on people.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: notice what it calls the dropping of the bombs. Miracles, because no one had ever seen nothing like that before. Their science is called miracles in the Bible. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: in the sight of Europe; the beast there is Europe.

“Saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: make an image and honor to Rome. That’s the white image of Jesus. The bust of the Savior was posed for by Caesar Borgia, the second son of Pope Alexander VI of Rome; the original was found in the Church of San Salvatore in Thermis, and it is an open secret that Caesar Borgia, the son of the pope, posed for it. His image was used as the Renaissance image, the new image of Christ. All the scholars know that image of the beast is Caesar Borgia. It’s the black and the Latino church that is totally unaware.

And what has this got to do with 1945? The Head of Christ, the Sallman head, a 1940 painting by the American artist Warner Sallman. The Baptist bookstore popularized it, and the Salvation Army and the YMCA, through the USO, handed out pocket-sized versions to American servicemen heading overseas in World War II. That image became famous during the war: all the servicemen carried it in their pockets to exhort them to carry on, to fight, to kill, to destroy. After the war groups campaigned to put it into private and public spaces. So they honored the wrong image, from Rome.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: we just read who the image actually is. It’s Caesar Borgia, but they gave it the life of Jesus Christ.

“That the image of the beast should both speak”: how does that damn image speak? They find an actor that looks like Caesar Borgia and have him speak the words of the Bible. That Jesus on the cross saying ‘Father forgive them’: that’s not how my king talks, that’s not how my king looks. That Jesus is a homosexual, a battyman. But that’s how the image speaks.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.” Back then, if we didn’t worship Christianity, white Jesus included, they literally killed us, northern kingdom and southern kingdom; they burned us alive too. The Roman Catholic Church epitomizes white supremacy, and all the various denominations, Orthodox, Jehovah’s Witness, Presbyterian, Lutheran, Methodist, Mormon, Episcopalian, Evangelical, Pentecostal, Baptist, Adventist, Anglican, Calvinist, stem from it. The Protestants say, no, we’re not with the Catholic Church. Oh yes they are. The only thing they protest is the pope being the Vicar of Christ, but nine out of ten they follow the teachings of the pope. They all follow white Jesus; they all believe in white supremacy. Man-made religions: John Smyth created the Baptist religion in 1608, Joseph Smith the Mormon religion in 1830, Ellen G. White the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863, Charles T. Russell the Jehovah’s Witness religion in 1872, and Charles Parham the Pentecostal religion in 1901.

I told you I’m going to keep going back and forth, from Daniel 8 to Revelation 13. “And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” The mighty and the holy people are the Israelites.

As the Israelites we went off into madness. Some of us became Muslims, and they called us Moors; some of us were Christians under white supremacy; and some of us always knew that we were the Jews. We were broken up into various names and denominations, spoke various languages. The Moors were the Israelites. J. A. Rogers wrote Nature Knows No Color-Line and found that many of the rulers of Europe were initially black men from the tribes of Israel; the books of crests of British families show the Moors of Yorkshire, including Sir Thomas More.

This is the rise of Esau Edom in the time of the Renaissance, when he began to slaughter the Israelites. In The Image of the Black in Western Art you see the black soldiers in the castles being attacked by white people: we lost the war, they were chopping us up. The white man storming the castle we were in, murdering and enslaving us. The wildlings, the wild men, like in Game of Thrones: the hairy beasts who did not have a Gillette shave. They were the rapers and robbers and murderers. This is how he destroyed wonderfully the mighty and the holy people. They enslaved us and put yokes of iron on our necks, like it says in Deuteronomy 28. They conquered us, destroyed us.

And this is worldwide. They didn’t just stop in France or Germany; they went wherever they found us, southern kingdom and northern kingdom. Hernán Cortés and the rest went throughout the globe under the direction of the Roman Catholic Church, slaughtering us through Latin America, Central and South America. There was an Indian slave trade too: they sold the native Indians throughout Latin America into slavery. They even got our people that were in Australia: a work gang of chained indigenous Australians, around 1900.

Notice that when our people see these pictures of us in chains, it evokes no kind of reaction. Why? Because we’ve gotten used to seeing it. That’s psychological damage. But when we see Esau in it, it evokes a reaction, because it’s something we’re not used to seeing. Think about the subconscious damage: we see this and it’s normal, and we don’t bat an eye.

So they destroyed us already. That is verse 24.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”. In order to understand the policy, you have to go through biblical precepts to find out what policies were already established, and we can get a general idea of what’s going to happen.

Policy: ‘a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, party, business, or individual.’ So Revelation 13 is talking about a policy imposed by a government. Look at the similar words: plan, strategy, proposed action, blueprint, approach, scheme, program, code, system, guidelines, line, position, practice, custom, procedure, routine, pattern, convention, rule. His policy goes back to what we read in Revelation 13 about that mark: you can’t buy or sell unless you have the mark of sin. That’s the policy it’s talking about.

“And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: this guy calls himself Christ’s replacement on earth. This man says he is God. That’s the magnification.

“And by peace shall destroy many”: he is going to kill a whole lot of people. We read at the bottom of verse 24 that we’ve been destroyed already, then the next verse comes back and says he shall destroy many. But we’re already destroyed, so what’s it talking about? Something’s going on here. This is war. Everybody says, I will never turn my back on Christ. Most of you got cute babies: let them cute little babies start to starve, and see what you’re going to do. You’re going to see the real from the fake.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: the Prince of princes is the black Messiah, Jesus the Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand”: Christ is going to destroy this man without hand.

precepts.why: Talking about the same thing as Daniel 8:24. “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints”: the mighty and holy people are the saints. “And to overcome them”: they overcame us and enslaved us. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: they ruled the earth.

This is a policy that was already established. “Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.” Antiochus: remember, that’s Epiphanes, and it has the same meaning as the Vicar of Christ, the pope.

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” Don’t be shocked. Just like it was back then: the thing that has been is that which shall be, and there’s no new thing. Many of our people consented to Epiphanes’ religion back then, and in these last days he’s going to do the same thing.

“For the king had sent letters by messengers unto Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land”: so there will be an implementation of new laws, and everyone will be forced to follow those new laws. These are their policies. Forbid the burnt offerings, profane the sabbaths and festival days, pollute the sanctuary and holy people, set up altars and groves and chapels of idols, sacrifice swine’s flesh, leave their children uncircumcised, “and make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation”. Why? “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” We got to make these people forget God’s law.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” We just read that in Revelation 13: as many as would not worship the image should be killed. It will happen again.

And all should be one people: look at the Abrahamic Family House in Abu Dhabi, three buildings, a mosque, a synagogue and a church. They’re attempting to unite all religions, to make everybody coexist. The pope in multi-faith Singapore says all religions are a path to God: whatever religion you’re in leads the same way, and he’s uniting all the leaders worldwide. Keep your eye on this man.

All that sin in 1 Maccabees 1 was going on already. When did it become official? When the Greeks enforced it, and the righteous fought against it.

Not being allowed to buy or sell is a tool to force compliance, when sin officially becomes the mark. “And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”. The question is always, what is the mark? The mark is sin, the lawful practice of sin.

Everybody sins: adultery, whatever, do whatever you want. So when does it become, quote unquote, the mark? When it’s enforced, like we just read in 1 Maccabees 1. When certain things are implemented, when sin becomes law and this, the law of God, becomes outlawed: that’s the mark. Then you’re going to have to choose you this day what you shall do.

You may say, I would never do that. How will they force people to comply? “And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.” Control of the economic system: that’s how they get compliance from the masses of people. Look at central bank digital currencies: completely controlled by the government, every transaction tracked, accounts frozen or balances altered if deemed necessary. You participate in a protest and the government could freeze your funds or limit your spending. You get punished through financial means. That is the policy of Daniel 8:25.

What is the mark? “If I sin, then thou markest me”. The mark is sin. So the mark in the right hand or in the forehead that the beast causes all to receive, which is his policy in Daniel 8:25, is sin made into law.

“And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand”. You got to slow down on that part: in her hand, “full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”. Remember we read earlier, a mark in your hand or in your forehead. In her hand, which represents America, are abominations.

“And upon her forehead”: the forehead is your mind. “Was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” That’s America. That’s Rome. To sum it all up, that’s Esau, the so-called white man. That makes it simple for everybody. Don’t try to figure out is it this guy or that guy, he just died. It’s them as a whole; they work together.

What “by peace shall destroy many” means. “For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord.” This is what Christ was warning us about in Matthew 24; this is what happened in 1 Maccabees 1. “They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear the Lord. For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.” Take away the goods, cast us out of our houses: that will be the penalty for going against the government, against the system. That’s what Revelation 13 was saying; it’s saying the same thing.

“Then shall they be known, who are my chosen”. This is why all these classes are meant to build us up. The marriage class that the Bishop went over today is to bring us closer to the one true God, because right now we are in chaos in our marriages: this one married to that one, got a divorce, married that one over there. It’s filthiness, wickedness, debauchery, and the Most High said, I ain’t dealing with that. Get yourselves together so I can draw nearer to you and open more wisdom to you. “And they shall be tried as the gold in the fire”: all of us, man, woman, boy, girl, are going to be tried.

“Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand”. Get ready. “But I will deliver you from the same.” God promised. Be not afraid, “neither doubt”. Why is God allowing my baby to starve? It’s a trying time, to try and test our faith. If you are willingly sinning now, what makes you believe you’re going to endure when they’re forcing you to sin? There’s nobody forcing you to fornicate now. So what are you going to do then? You’re going to turn against us and against the Lord. In that time you’re going to find out who believes. It’s time for us now to get our minds right so we can endure.

“For God is your guide, And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts”: God is only the guide of them that keep the commandments. “Let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.” Why I got to stay married to this dude, why I got to stay married to this woman, I’m going to leave and get somebody new: no, don’t let your iniquities rise up in you.

“Woe be unto them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!” There’s no scripture we can reach you with; we can’t pull you out of that, you’re so bound up in your sin. “It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed therewith.” That’s destruction.

2 Esdras 16 says be not afraid, and Isaiah 10 says the same thing about the Assyrian. “Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt. For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.” Don’t fear him: when the days of trouble come and they smite us, the Lord will deliver us from the same.

We’re still dealing with “by peace shall destroy many”; here’s another example. “And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: deceivableness means deceit, and unrighteousness means sin, breaking God’s laws. “In them that perish”: meaning destined to die. “Because they received not the love of the truth”: the truth is Christ, keeping the commandments. ‘I ain’t keeping no commandments, to hell with that black Jesus crap.’ “That they might be saved”: they rejected that.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion”: America is the way, the Roman Catholic Church, the pope is the way. “That they should believe a lie”: I believe whatever the white man has said. “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.” Our people trust in American society: vote, vote, vote, and in the political and religious ones.

That’s what Revelation 13 was saying about the mark. When the Bible talks about the mark in Revelation 13, it’s saying the same thing in Thessalonians, and the same thing in Daniel 8. It’s not saying nothing different. We got to be able to put the precepts together and see this is talking about the same damn thing.

A precept to “he shall be broken without hand”. “And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth”: he saw America and all the nations. “And their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse”: to make war against Christ. “And against his army”: Christ’s army, the angels.

“And the beast was taken”: America was taken, the white man was taken. “And with him the false prophet”: that’s the pope and the entire church system. “That wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.” These both: the beast is America, their politics and all that, and the false prophet is the pope and that whole religious church system.

“And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth”: that’s the word of God, the sword that proceeds out of his mouth. “And all the fowls were filled with their flesh.”

The next precept. “And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came”: that’s nations warring. “He neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war”. Didn’t we read in Daniel 8 he shall be broken without hand? Christ ain’t coming back with no instrument. Christ don’t need no particular instrument of war; he is the instrument of war.

“And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war”: remember, this white man shall be broken without hand. “But that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation: Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.” That’s you and me. Him waking us up is the beginning of the process: waking us up to the truth that we’re the Israelites and we must keep the commandments.

“And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth. And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another”: the spirit realm and the physical realm. “And then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending”: then shall Christ appear.

“And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as thou sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting. But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion. And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men”: everybody is going to know that we’re the Israelites; they’re going to see us. “Being prepared and builded, like as thou sawest the hill graven without hands.”

“And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest”. So the Lord don’t care about the ICBM, the hydrogen bomb, the atomic bomb, the nuclear intercontinental ballistic missile; he don’t give a damn about none of that. “And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law”. Do y’all see that? This is what Daniel 8 was saying: he shall be broken without hand. He destroys them without labour, by the law, and the word of God is that fire.
